caption: The drawing consists of several objects arranged symmetrically on a beige, textured background. At the top is a yellow cross with red outlines and blue decorative accents inside its shape. Behind the base of the cross, short yellow lines radiate outward, resembling rays. Directly below the cross is a bow-like shape, made up of four elongated oval loops, each outlined in red and blue with yellow and blue dotted details inside, all meeting at a central circle containing a small blue cross. On both sides of this bow-like shape are two yellow, stylized wings or feathers, each with three red-tipped segments. Below the bow and wings, there is a large circular medallion divided into concentric sections. The medallion features intricate patterns mostly in yellow, blue, and red, including alternating pointed and rounded motifs that radiate from a central blue and yellow circle, forming a symmetrical geometric pattern. The overall composition is vertically aligned, with the cross at the top, bow and wings in the middle, and medallion at the bottom. The colors throughout are muted shades of yellow, blue, and red.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
